description: Capabilities for the pinned monitor window. The pin button and hotkey/tray forwarding go through this app's own commands (set_always_on_top, report_state), which are not plugin commands and so are not ACL-gated; the only capability the frontend actually needs is listening for the hotkey/tray events those forward. Dragging is granted explicitly rather than relied on from core:default, because a window with decorations off has no other way to be moved.
